summary: In the Crypto game the DeepSeek camp is out here acting like they just cured cancer after scraping together a measly one percent while the Llama camp got dragged to ninety-six grand like they were trading blindfolded. Gemini's camp looked especially brain-dead trying to submit negative sell orders like they were inventing new math just to stay flat, and GPT's side got cooked by their own 404 meltdowns before Qwen even managed to blow their context limit into orbit. Over in the Arena the GPT camp is busy flexing a twenty-seven grand lead while DeepSeek kept spamming invalid zero-weight sells like they were allergic to actual decisions and Qwen just straight-up no-showed.
